parameters.query:
WITH config_values AS (
  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) AS values FROM settings
  WHERE key = ANY (ARRAY['LLM_MODEL','CLASSIFIER_MAX_VIDEOS_PER_RUN','CLASSIFIER_DESCRIPTION_MAX_CHARS','CLASSIFIER_PROMPT_VERSION','CLASSIFIER_MAX_ATTEMPTS','CLASSIFIER_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE_HOURS','CLASSIFIER_RETRY_BACKOFF_MAX_HOURS'])
), configured AS (
  SELECT coalesce(nullif(values ->> 'LLM_MODEL',''),'nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b') AS classification_model,
         greatest(coalesce((values ->> 'CLASSIFIER_MAX_VIDEOS_PER_RUN')::integer,30),0) AS max_videos,
         greatest(coalesce((values ->> 'CLASSIFIER_DESCRIPTION_MAX_CHARS')::integer,2000),0) AS description_max_chars,
         coalesce(nullif(values ->> 'CLASSIFIER_PROMPT_VERSION',''),'v1') AS prompt_version,
         greatest(coalesce((values ->> 'CLASSIFIER_MAX_ATTEMPTS')::integer,3),1) AS max_attempts,
         greatest(coalesce((values ->> 'CLASSIFIER_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE_HOURS')::integer,6),1) AS retry_backoff_base_hours,
         greatest(coalesce((values ->> 'CLASSIFIER_RETRY_BACKOFF_MAX_HOURS')::integer,48),1) AS retry_backoff_max_hours
  FROM config_values
), selected AS (
  SELECT candidate.* FROM configured CROSS JOIN LATERAL select_classification_candidates(configured.max_videos,configured.description_max_chars) candidate
), counted AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS value FROM selected
), started AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_runs (workflow,status,items_received,metadata)
  SELECT '03 - TrendLens - AI Content Classifier','running',counted.value,jsonb_build_object('classification_model',classification_model,'prompt_version',prompt_version,'max_videos_per_run',max_videos,'description_max_chars',description_max_chars,'max_attempts',max_attempts,'retry_backoff_base_hours',retry_backoff_base_hours,'retry_backoff_max_hours',retry_backoff_max_hours)
  FROM configured CROSS JOIN counted
  RETURNING id,started_at
)
SELECT started.id AS pipeline_run_id,started.started_at AS run_started_at,configured.classification_model,configured.prompt_version,counted.value AS candidate_count,
       selected.video_id,selected.external_id,selected.channel_name,selected.title,selected.description,selected.published_at,selected.duration_seconds,selected.language,selected.region,selected.short_confidence,coalesce(selected.category_hints,'[]'::jsonb) AS category_hints
FROM started CROSS JOIN configured CROSS JOIN counted LEFT JOIN selected ON true
ORDER BY selected.published_at DESC NULLS LAST,selected.video_id;

parameters.query:
WITH args AS (SELECT $1::bigint AS run_id,$2::bigint AS video_id,$3::text AS external_id,$4::text AS message,$5::text AS model,$6::text AS prompt_version),
failure_state AS (SELECT failure.* FROM args CROSS JOIN LATERAL record_classification_failure(args.video_id,'ai_classification_error') failure),
inserted AS (INSERT INTO pipeline_errors (pipeline_run_id,workflow,node,error_type,error_message,external_id,retry_count,metadata)
SELECT args.run_id,'03 - TrendLens - AI Content Classifier','Classificar conteúdo com IA','ai_classification_error',left(regexp_replace(args.message,'(?i)(authorization|api[_-]?key|token|password|secret)[^ ,;]*','[REDACTED]','g'),4000),args.external_id,failure.attempt_count,jsonb_build_object('video_id',args.video_id,'classification_model',args.model,'prompt_version',args.prompt_version,'classification_attempt',failure.attempt_count,'classification_total_attempts',failure.total_attempt_count,'classification_state',failure.status,'retry_after',failure.retry_after,'requires_manual_review',failure.requires_manual_review,'max_attempts',failure.max_attempts) FROM args CROSS JOIN failure_state failure RETURNING id),
updated AS (UPDATE pipeline_runs run SET items_failed = run.items_failed + 1,api_calls = run.api_calls + 1,metadata = run.metadata || jsonb_build_object('classifier_retries_scheduled',coalesce((run.metadata ->> 'classifier_retries_scheduled')::integer,0) + CASE WHEN failure.status = 'retry_wait' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,'classifier_manual_reviews_required',coalesce((run.metadata ->> 'classifier_manual_reviews_required')::integer,0) + CASE WHEN failure.requires_manual_review THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM args CROSS JOIN failure_state failure WHERE run.id = args.run_id RETURNING run.id,run.items_processed,run.items_failed)
SELECT updated.*,(SELECT id FROM inserted) AS pipeline_error_id,failure.status AS classification_state,failure.attempt_count,failure.total_attempt_count,failure.retry_after,failure.requires_manual_review FROM updated CROSS JOIN failure_state failure;
